get.summary: Search published tours with an available departure in the next 365 days
get.description: Each result carries its next bookable departure for the searched date and group, with live seat counts. cityId (from GET /cities), or a city name that matches a known place, searches within radiusKm (default 25) of that place and fills distanceKm; sort=Nearest orders by it. country (ISO code, e.g. RS) limits to one country; a city value that is a whole country name ("Serbia") searches that country. q (free text, e.g. "calm boat trip for a family") orders the matching tours by meaning (sort=Relevance, the default with q); semantic=false means it was unavailable and the normal order was used.
